changelog: Insert a single narrow binding into [Core Principles] that keeps a finite verb/auxiliary with the immediately following core complement, addressing the primary_finding that cuts detach verbs from their essential continuations.

Insert a single narrow binding into [Core Principles] that keeps a numeral/quantifier with its immediately following unit or adjacent parenthetical measurement, to prevent splits that break numeric meaning (addresses the primary_finding).

Insert a single fallback ordering into [Core Principles] that, as a last resort, prefers cuts at punctuation or clause boundaries over cuts that split a finite verb/auxiliary from its immediately following complement or that split a numeral from its unit — addresses the primary_finding without adding a prohibition.

Insert a single fallback ordering after C8: as a last resort prefer punctuation/clause-boundary cuts over cuts that split a numeral from its unit/measurement or that separate a finite verb/auxiliary from its immediately following core complement—implements the required fallback order (addresses the primary finding about numerals) without adding a prohibition.

Delete C2: remove a broad, redundant coherence rule that restates predicate-argument, attachment and referent-preservation checks (covered by C3, C4, C7, C8); pruning this unit reduces overlap that can dilute the judge and directly responds to the critique's call to sharpen focus on verb-complement binding.

Insert one induced binding after C8: keep a finite verb/auxiliary with the immediately following core complement or clausal continuation (including measurements) and keep a numeral/quantifier with its immediately adjacent unit or parenthetical measurement — addresses measured cases where verbs or numbers were split from their required continuation.

Insert one induced binding into [Core Principles] to keep finite verbs/auxiliaries with their immediately following core complements (including measurements) and to keep numerals/quantifiers with their immediately adjacent unit or parenthetical measurement — reproduces measured target cuts that rejoin verbs and numbers to their continuations.
